title: Arc leak, c = 1/2: in a normalized fan-in-two AND/OR list right on arcs of a plane of order q, leaking lines pay q/2 gates each, uncharged elsewhere
plain: Order q plane: q^2 + q + 1 points and lines, q + 1 on a line, two points on one line; arc: at most two points per line. Fan-in-two AND/OR list; S_g: points where wire g is 1 with only that point on; gates with |S_g| <= 1 equal OR of S_g. Output t_l is OR of l on arcs. Core of l: gates reached from t_l via gates with S_g inside l; boundary: wires a read by a core AND gate, S_a not inside l. l leaks if no arc missing l meets S_a for every boundary a. Then q times the leaking lines is at most twice the gates without |S_g| >= 2 inside a non-leaking line. Conjecture.
formal: ∀ (q N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin N → ℕ), N = q * q + q + 1 → (∀ l0 : Fin N, (Finset.univ.filter (fun p0 : Fin N => I p0 l0)).card = q + 1) → (∀ p1 p2 : Fin N, p1 ≠ p2 → ∃! l1 : Fin N, I p1 l1 ∧ I p2 l1) → (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ ak : ℕ, ak < gates.length → (Finset.univ.filter (fun au : Fin N => (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun auk : Fin N => decide (auk = au)))).getD (N + ak) false = true)).card ≤ 1 → ∀ ax : Fin N → Bool, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn ax)).getD (N + ak) false = decide (∃ av : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun avk : Fin N => decide (avk = av)))).getD (N + ak) false = true ∧ ax av = true)) → (∀ (l2 : Fin N) (x : Fin N → Bool), (∀ cl : Fin N, (Finset.univ.filter (fun cp : Fin N => I cp cl ∧ x cp = true)).card ≤ 2) → (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn x)).getD (out l2) false = decide (∃ p3 : Fin N, I p3 l2 ∧ x p3 = true)) → ∀ (B : Finset (Fin N)) (H : Finset (Fin gates.length)), (∀ l3 ∈ B, ¬ (∃ ey : Fin N → Bool, (∀ eal : Fin N, (Finset.univ.filter (fun eap : Fin N => I eap eal ∧ ey eap = true)).card ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ ep0 : Fin N, I ep0 l3 → ey ep0 = false) ∧ ∀ ebw : ℕ, (∃ (ebk : ℕ) (ebg : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), (∀ ebK : Set ℕ, (∀ ebk0 : ℕ, ebk0 < gates.length → out l3 = N + ebk0 → (∀ ebu0 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun ebu0k : Fin N => decide (ebu0k = ebu0)))).getD (N + ebk0) false = true → ebu0 ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun es : Fin N => I es l3))) → ebk0 ∈ ebK) → (∀ ebk1 ∈ ebK, ∀ (ebg1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (ebk2 : ℕ), gates[ebk1]? = some ebg1 → N + ebk2 ∈ ebg1.inputs → ebk2 < ebk1 → (∀ ebu1 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun ebu1k : Fin N => decide (ebu1k = ebu1)))).getD (N + ebk2) false = true → ebu1 ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun es : Fin N => I es l3))) → ebk2 ∈ ebK) → ebk ∈ ebK) ∧ gates[ebk]? = some ebg ∧ ebg.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ ebw ∈ ebg.inputs ∧ ebw < N + ebk ∧ ¬ (∀ ebu2 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun ebu2k : Fin N => decide (ebu2k = ebu2)))).getD (ebw) false = true → ebu2 ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun es : Fin N => I es l3)))) → ∃ eu4 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun eu4k : Fin N => decide (eu4k = eu4)))).getD (ebw) false = true ∧ ey eu4 = true)) → (∀ k5 ∈ H, 2 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun u5 : Fin N => (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun u5k : Fin N => decide (u5k = u5)))).getD (N + k5.val) false = true)).card ∧ ∃ l4 : Fin N, (∃ fy : Fin N → Bool, (∀ fal : Fin N, (Finset.univ.filter (fun fap : Fin N => I fap fal ∧ fy fap = true)).card ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ fp0 : Fin N, I fp0 l4 → fy fp0 = false) ∧ ∀ fbw : ℕ, (∃ (fbk : ℕ) (fbg : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), (∀ fbK : Set ℕ, (∀ fbk0 : ℕ, fbk0 < gates.length → out l4 = N + fbk0 → (∀ fbu0 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun fbu0k : Fin N => decide (fbu0k = fbu0)))).getD (N + fbk0) false = true → fbu0 ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun fs : Fin N => I fs l4))) → fbk0 ∈ fbK) → (∀ fbk1 ∈ fbK, ∀ (fbg1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (fbk2 : ℕ), gates[fbk1]? = some fbg1 → N + fbk2 ∈ fbg1.inputs → fbk2 < fbk1 → (∀ fbu1 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun fbu1k : Fin N => decide (fbu1k = fbu1)))).getD (N + fbk2) false = true → fbu1 ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun fs : Fin N => I fs l4))) → fbk2 ∈ fbK) → fbk ∈ fbK) ∧ gates[fbk]? = some fbg ∧ fbg.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ fbw ∈ fbg.inputs ∧ fbw < N + fbk ∧ ¬ (∀ fbu2 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun fbu2k : Fin N => decide (fbu2k = fbu2)))).getD (fbw) false = true → fbu2 ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun fs : Fin N => I fs l4)))) → ∃ fu4 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun fu4k : Fin N => decide (fu4k = fu4)))).getD (fbw) false = true ∧ fy fu4 = true) ∧ ∀ u6 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun u6k : Fin N => decide (u6k = u6)))).getD (N + k5.val) false = true → I u6 l4) → q * B.card + 2 * H.card ≤ 2 * gates.length

title: A redundant vector raises the rank above the number of essential vectors (standalone text)
plain: For any finite family of nonzero rational vectors in which some member lies in the span of the others, the dimension of the span of the whole family is at least one more than the number of members that do not lie in the span of the others.
formal:
∀ (k m : ℕ) (r : Fin k → (Fin m → ℚ)),
    (∀ i, r i ≠ 0) →
    (∃ j : Fin k, r j ∈ Submodule.span ℚ (r '' {l | l ≠ j})) →
    Nat.card {i : Fin k // r i ∉ Submodule.span ℚ (r '' {j | j ≠ i})} + 1 ≤
      Module.finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range r))
